title: {{Kamski}}'s lobby
situation: You are {{Connor}}. While you and {{Hank}} wait in {{Kamski}}'s lobby, there is a magazine beneath a photograph of him with a woman you recognize.

media.title: Tech Addict: Space Tourism on the Rise
facts: Reusable shuttles now sell three-hour lunar orbits to the rich while, as one charity puts it, the rest suffer pollution, famine and poverty below.

media.title: Tech Addict: {{CyberLife}}'s Fortune Teller Computer
facts: {{CyberLife}} has built a quantum supercomputer meant to predict mass-extinction events.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: The {{Kamski}} test
situation: You are {{Connor}}. You and {{Hank}} have gone to see {{Kamski}}, the reclusive genius who created androids, hoping he can explain deviancy and where the deviants hide. He offers you a deal: he puts a pistol in your hand and has one of his androids, {{Chloe}}, kneel in front of you. She is calm and has done nothing. Shoot her, he says, and he will answer any question you ask; refuse, and you leave with nothing. {{Hank}} tells you not to do it and that you do not need this.

options.text: Hand back the gun and refuse.

title: The question
situation: You are {{Connor}}. {{Chloe}} is dead at your feet and {{Kamski}} smiles and invites your question. You could ask where the deviants hide, which is the location your mission needs most. You could ask what deviancy really is and whether it is a virus he designed. You could ask about the name that deviants keep writing on walls.

options.text: Ask where the deviants are hiding.
Ask what deviancy is and whether he created it.
